commit: cf1736f (last server change: 1afd3a1); server tree clean
target: http://localhost:8080/{slug}, one active link, 302 to https://example.com/k6
path: k6 -> Go API over plain HTTP (no proxy, no TLS) -> in-process cache; every click recorded through the Redis stream into PostgreSQL

host.machine: laptop, also running a desktop session, code editor and browser during the runs
host.cpu: Intel Core i7-8706G, 4 cores / 8 threads, up to 4.1 GHz

load_generator.script: benchmarks/2026-10-12-production/scripts/redirect-live.js in IbrahimIjai/sh.sh, with the warm-up timed from the scenario start
load_generator.location: same laptop, so it shared the CPU with the services under test
load_generator.user_agent: desktop Chrome string; every click was recorded as human (is_bot = false)

api.process: native, started with go run ./cmd/api (go1.26.2); no container or CPU limits, default GOMAXPROCS (8)
api.app_env: development (changes cookie flags, not the redirect path)

postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 (postgres:17-alpine) in Docker, default configuration, no resource limits, reached on localhost:5434
redis: Redis 7.2.16 (redis:7.2-alpine) in Docker, appendonly yes, maxmemory 256mb, volatile-lru, no resource limits, reached on localhost:6380

runs.shape: 20 s ramp to the target rate, then 60 s held. Only the held window is reported in the hold_* metrics.
runs.summary-10000.json: RATE=10000 PRE_VUS=500 MAX_VUS=3000; k6-10000.png is this run's terminal output
runs.earlier_attempt: A previous 10,000 r/s run delivered 9,558 r/s during the hold (p95 39.3 ms, 26,727 dropped iterations, 0 errors) and stored all 683,104 clicks. Its summary was overwritten by the published run.

reconciliation.method: clicks for the test link counted in PostgreSQL before and after each run, once the stream had drained; sh:clicks and sh:clicks:dead lengths checked afterwards

measurement.cpu: 4000 run only: pidstat (api, k6, postgres, redis-server) and mpstat sampled every second for 58 s of the held window. Figures are in logical CPUs. Docker's port proxy, the kernel and desktop applications are not in the per-process figures. Hostnames are redacted.
